facts.business: Aanjaay Industries Limited (formerly Kabra Drugs Limited) commenced manufacturing with trading operations during FY 2025-26, recognizing revenue of Rs 9,274.00 lakhs from sale of products with corresponding purchase of stock-in-trade of Rs 8,366.40 lakhs.
key_risks: Revenue recognition in new manufacturing with trading model at narrow margin (9.8%) without inventory held at beginning or end of year
Determination of principal vs agent classification in trading arrangements
No permanent employees in the company
No manufacturing activities carried out previously (transition year)
